name: Yorkshire Pudding
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Mix salt and flour, and add milk gradually to form a smooth paste; then add eggs beaten until very light.
Cover bottom of hot pan with some of beef fat tried out from roast, pour mixture in pan one-half inch deep.
Bake twenty minutes in hot oven, basting after well risen, with some of the fat from pan in which meat is roasting.
Bake, if preferred, in greased, hissing hot iron gem pans.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
